description: VFX / gosFX rendering variants: GPU particle batcher gate plus the Track-V VFX-payoff stack (soft particles, lit particles, bloom participation). All payoff gates are default-OFF; entries below opt them in for capture.

entries.description: Default VFX settings (MC2_GPU_PARTICLES default-ON, gosFX CPU sim active, all payoff gates OFF). Byte-identical baseline.
GPU particle batcher disabled (MC2_GPU_PARTICLES=0). Pure legacy gosFX CPU path.
Post stack only (HDR + bloom + ACES tonemap), no VFX-payoff gates. Isolates the post contribution so payoff entries can be compared against it.
VFX-SOFT-PARTICLES-MVP-1: depth-fade alpha particles at scene intersections (MC2_VFX_SOFT_PARTICLES=1). Look for soft smoke/dust where it meets terrain/mechs instead of hard billboard edges.
VFX-LIT-PARTICLES-MVP-1: scene-lit alpha smoke/dust (MC2_VFX_LIT_PARTICLES=1). Smoke should take on the mission sun/ambient tint; additive flashes unchanged.
VFX-BLOOM-PARTICIPATION-1: HDR+bloom with additive VFX pushed over the bright-pass threshold (MC2_TUNE_VFX_ADDITIVE_BRIGHTNESS=2.0). Muzzle flashes / PPC / explosions should glow.
Full VFX-payoff stack: soft + lit particles + HDR + bloom + tonemap. The headline 'after' shot for the opus.
VFX-DEBUG-VIEWS-1 ParticleKind view (MC2_VFX_DEBUG_MODE=3): distinct color per particle kind. Diagnostic-only.
VFX-DEBUG-VIEWS-1 Overdraw view (MC2_VFX_DEBUG_MODE=4): additive proxy reveals particle blend buildup. Diagnostic-only.

VFX-ORIGINALS-LOCKDOWN-1: oracle render ON (default) + log. Verifies CardCloud/ShardCloud/Card oracle fires and Tube/Shape classes fall through to CPU MLR. mc2_10=missile smoke via Tube MLR, mc2_24=PPC trail via Tube MLR + oracle dust/sparks. Regression guard: [VFX_ORACLE v1] lines should appear for CardCloud/ShardCloud/Card but NOT for Tube (Tube has no oracle log output — it goes to MLR directly).

VFX-ORIGINALS-LOCKDOWN-1: oracle disabled. CardCloud/ShardCloud/Card/PointCloud fall to Spawn placeholders (near-invisible). Tube/Shape/ShapeCloud/DebrisCloud render via CPU MLR swept-mesh only. Regression guard: missile smoke and PPC trail must still be visible (Tube MLR active), oracle dust/sparks will be dim/missing. MC2_DISABLE_GOSFX must NOT be set — that would suppress Tube/Shape too.
